instructions: Open book. Answer each item from the saved AWS pages and the fact canon only. Give citations for every label: why the key is right and why each other option is wrong. A citation is a fact id or {source_id, quote} with a verbatim quote. Set flag when a second answer is defensible, else null.

items.stem: A company sells furniture online. Its product pages load images from one Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region, and the images change only a few times each year. The company now has users around the world. Users in Asia and Europe report that product pages load slowly because each image takes a long time to download. The company wants to reduce the time that these users wait for the images. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as its origin, and load the product images through the domain name of the distribution.

options.label: B
options.text: Launch Amazon EC2 instances in the edge locations near users in Asia and Europe, and copy the product images to the instances.

options.label: C
options.text: Turn on S3 Transfer Acceleration for the bucket, and load the product images through the accelerated endpoint name of the bucket.

options.label: D
options.text: Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator with the S3 bucket as its endpoint, so that edge locations keep copies of the images.

items.stem: A company serves a static website from an Amazon S3 bucket in us-east-1 through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Visitors read pages and download files, and they never upload anything. S3 Cross-Region Replication copies every object to a second bucket in us-west-2. The website must stay highly available if the us-east-1 bucket starts to return server errors during a Regional problem. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator with both buckets as endpoints, and let its health checks move the traffic to the us-west-2 bucket.

options.label: B
options.text: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm on the 5xx error rate of the distribution, and let the alarm start a script that changes the origin of the distribution to the us-west-2 bucket.

options.label: C
options.text: Create an origin group that fails over from the us-east-1 bucket to the us-west-2 bucket on 5xx status codes, and use the group in the default cache behavior.

options.label: D
options.text: Associate a Lambda@Edge function with the origin response event, and let the function fetch the file from the us-west-2 bucket when the us-east-1 bucket returns an error.

items.stem: A company hosts the static assets of a web application in an Amazon S3 bucket. The API of the application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The browser sends API calls to paths that start with /api/, and every other path is a static asset. All requests must use one domain name. Static assets must be cached at edge locations, and API responses must not be cached. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator with the bucket and the load balancer as endpoints, and send the /api/ paths to the load balancer endpoint.

options.label: B
options.text: Create two CloudFront distributions, one with the bucket as its origin and one with the load balancer as its origin, and give each distribution its own domain name.

options.label: C
options.text: Copy the static assets to the EC2 instances, and create one CloudFront distribution with the load balancer as its origin and a /api/* behavior that uses CachingDisabled.

options.label: D
options.text: Create one CloudFront distribution with both origins, a /api/* cache behavior for the load balancer with CachingDisabled, and a default cache behavior for the bucket.

items.stem: A company runs an online course website. Each course video uses HLS, so the video is split into hundreds of small segment files that the player requests one after another. The files are served through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Only signed-in subscribers can watch, and each subscriber must get temporary access to all files of a video. The company does not want to change the URLs that the video player requests. What should the company use to control access?

options.label: A
options.text: A CloudFront signed URL for each segment file, which the website creates for a subscriber after sign-in

options.label: B
options.text: An AWS WAF web ACL on the distribution that allows the IP addresses of signed-in subscribers

options.label: C
options.text: CloudFront geographic restriction that allows the countries where the subscribers of the company live

options.label: D
options.text: CloudFront signed cookies, which the website sets for a subscriber after sign-in, with an expiration time for the access

items.stem: A company runs a product catalog website on Amazon EC2 instances in one AWS Region behind an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Viewers are in many countries. The cache hit ratio is low, and the origin instances are overloaded. The cache policy of the distribution includes all query strings, all cookies and the User-Agent header in the cache key. Each catalog page changes only with the value of the lang query string. Which combination of steps will raise the cache hit ratio and reduce the origin load with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Attach a cache policy to the cache behavior that includes only the lang query string in the cache key, with no cookies and no headers.

options.label: B
options.text: Associate a CloudFront function with the viewer request event that removes all cookies, the User-Agent header and every query string except lang.

options.label: C
options.text: Turn on Origin Shield for the origin, and choose the AWS Region that has the lowest latency to the EC2 instances of the catalog.

options.label: D
options.text: Keep all cookies in the cache key, and add every other viewer header to it, so that each cached copy matches its request more exactly.

options.label: E
options.text: Create an invalidation for the /* path every hour, so that the edge locations keep a fresh copy of every catalog page.

items.stem: A company runs a payments API on Amazon EC2 instances behind Application Load Balancers in us-east-1 and us-west-2. Partner companies call the API with HTTPS POST requests. The firewalls of the partners allow outbound traffic only to IP addresses on an allow list, and the partners update their lists rarely. If the API fails in one Region, partner traffic must move automatically to another Region. Which solution will provide the FASTEST failover between the Regions?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator with an endpoint group in each Region for the Application Load Balancer of that Region, and give its static IP addresses to the partners.

options.label: B
options.text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin group that contains both Application Load Balancers, and fail over to the us-west-2 load balancer on 5xx status codes.

options.label: C
options.text: Attach Elastic IP addresses to the Application Load Balancer in each Region, and create Amazon Route 53 weighted records with health checks that point to those addresses.

options.label: D
options.text: Place a Network Load Balancer with Elastic IP addresses in front of each Application Load Balancer, and create Amazon Route 53 failover records with health checks for the Network Load Balancers.

items.stem: A news company serves its website to millions of readers through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The origin is a group of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer in one AWS Region. Most page requests are served from the CloudFront cache. A new feature needs a small piece of logic that runs for every viewer request. Each request must be rewritten to a language folder, such as /de/, based on the Accept-Language header of the request. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.label: A
options.text: Write the logic as a CloudFront function, and associate the function with the viewer request event of the default cache behavior of the distribution.

options.label: B
options.text: Write the logic as a Lambda@Edge function, and associate the function with the origin request event of the default cache behavior of the distribution.

options.label: C
options.text: Attach the managed CachingDisabled cache policy to the default cache behavior, and add the logic to the application that runs on the EC2 instances.

options.label: D
options.text: Write the logic as a Lambda@Edge function, and associate the function with the viewer request event of the default cache behavior of the distribution.

items.stem: A company runs a single-page web application from an Amazon S3 bucket through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The team deploys new JavaScript and CSS files several times each day under the same file names. After each deployment, some users keep running the old files, including users whose browser or corporate proxy kept a copy. The team creates invalidations for the changed files after each deployment, and the invalidation charges grow every month. Users must get the new files right after each deployment. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.label: A
options.text: Add a version identifier to the JavaScript and CSS file names in each deployment, give index.html a short TTL, and give the versioned files a long TTL.

options.label: B
options.text: Turn on S3 Versioning for the origin bucket, so that each deployment stores a new object version that CloudFront serves to users after the upload.

options.label: C
options.text: Keep the current file names, and create one invalidation for the /* path after each deployment, because a wildcard path counts as one invalidation path.

options.label: D
options.text: Set a Cache-Control max-age of 0 seconds on every file in the bucket, so that CloudFront, browsers and proxies revalidate each file with the origin on every request.

items.stem: A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The load balancer is internet-facing in public subnets. An Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the load balancer caches static pages at edge locations near users. A security review requires that the load balancer is no longer internet-facing and that users reach the application only through CloudFront. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an internal Application Load Balancer in private subnets, and run proxy instances in public subnets that accept traffic from CloudFront and forward it to the load balancer.

options.label: B
options.text: Keep the internet-facing load balancer in the public subnets, and allow inbound traffic in its security group only from the AWS-managed prefix list for CloudFront.

options.label: C
options.text: Keep the current load balancer as the origin, and attach origin access control to the load balancer origin so that it accepts signed CloudFront requests.

options.label: D
options.text: Create an internal Application Load Balancer in private subnets for the instances, and add the internal load balancer to the distribution as a VPC origin.

items.stem: A company distributes installers for its desktop software from an Amazon S3 bucket in us-east-1. Users around the world download the installers directly from the bucket, and each new version is downloaded millions of times in its first week. Users far from us-east-1 report slow downloads, and the data transfer charges of the bucket keep growing. The company must reduce download times and keep data transfer costs low. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.label: A
options.text: Move the installers to Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer, and put an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator in front of the load balancer.

options.label: B
options.text: Turn on S3 Transfer Acceleration for the bucket, and change the download links to use the accelerated endpoint name of the bucket.

options.label: C
options.text: Replicate the bucket to S3 buckets in Europe and Asia with S3 Cross-Region Replication, and send each user to the nearest bucket instead of paying CloudFront transfer charges.

options.label: D
options.text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the bucket as its origin, and change the download links to use the domain name of the distribution.

items.stem: A news company serves its website to millions of readers through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The origin is a group of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer in one AWS Region. Most page requests are served from the CloudFront cache. A new feature needs a small piece of logic that runs for every viewer request. Each request must be checked against a list of blocked reader accounts in an Amazon DynamoDB table, and blocked readers must get an error page. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.label: A
options.text: Write the logic as a CloudFront function, and associate the function with the viewer request event of the default cache behavior of the distribution.

options.label: B
options.text: Write the logic as a Lambda@Edge function, and associate the function with the viewer request event of the default cache behavior of the distribution.

options.label: C
options.text: Write the logic as a Lambda@Edge function, and associate the function with the origin request event of the default cache behavior of the distribution.

options.label: D
options.text: Attach the managed CachingDisabled cache policy to the default cache behavior, and add the logic to the application that runs on the EC2 instances.

items.stem: A gaming company runs game servers on Amazon EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Players worldwide connect to these servers, many of them through partner networks. Players send their moves over UDP, and partner networks must allow-list a fixed set of IP addresses. The company wants to improve response times for players who are far from both Regions. Which solution will provide the LOWEST latency for players?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator with one listener and an endpoint group for the Network Load Balancer in each of the two Regions.

options.label: B
options.text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the two Network Load Balancers as origins, and point the game client at the domain name of the distribution.

options.label: C
options.text: Create Amazon Route 53 latency-based records that point to the two Network Load Balancers, and point the game client at the name of the records.

options.label: D
options.text: Turn on Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration for a bucket that stores the game data, and point the game client at the accelerated endpoint of the bucket.

items.stem: A company serves an online store at shop.example.com through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The origin is an internet-facing Application Load Balancer in eu-central-1, and the distribution reaches it at origin.example.com. The viewer protocol policy redirects HTTP to HTTPS, and the distribution uses an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for shop.example.com. A security review finds that the load balancer has only an HTTP listener. The company must ensure that data is encrypted in transit all the way to the load balancer. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Configure field-level encryption for the form fields that hold customer data, so that CloudFront encrypts those fields before it forwards each request to the load balancer.

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the load balancer with a Network Load Balancer that passes TCP port 443 to the instances, and install a certificate from a third-party authority on each instance.

options.label: C
options.text: Change the viewer protocol policy to HTTPS Only, so that CloudFront refuses HTTP requests from viewers and keeps each request encrypted on its way to the load balancer.

options.label: D
options.text: Request an ACM certificate for origin.example.com in eu-central-1, add an HTTPS listener with it to the load balancer, and set the origin protocol policy to HTTPS only.

items.stem: A company runs a banking API behind an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The origin returns account balances with the header Cache-Control: no-cache. The /api/* cache behavior uses a custom cache policy, created by a former team member, with a Minimum TTL of 3600 seconds. After a payment, users see their old balance for up to an hour. Each balance request must return the current balance. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Change the mobile and web clients to send the header Cache-Control: no-cache with each balance request, so that CloudFront fetches a fresh copy from the origin.

options.label: B
options.text: Edit the custom cache policy of the /api/* cache behavior, and set its Minimum TTL to 0 seconds so that the origin's headers decide caching.

options.label: C
options.text: Keep the cache policy as it is, and change the origin so that each balance response also carries the Cache-Control directives no-store and private.

options.label: D
options.text: Change the mobile and web clients to add a unique query string value to each balance request, and include all query strings in the cache key.

items.stem: A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an internet-facing Application Load Balancer. The load balancer is the origin of an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Attackers now send requests to the DNS name of the load balancer directly, which bypasses the protections at CloudFront. The load balancer must stay internet-facing until a network redesign next quarter. The company must allow only requests that come through CloudFront to reach the application. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Add a deny rule to the network ACL of the load balancer subnets for each IP address that sends requests directly to the load balancer.

options.label: B
options.text: Configure origin access control on the load balancer origin, so that CloudFront signs each request and the load balancer rejects every request without a signature.

options.label: C
options.text: In the security group of the load balancer, allow inbound HTTPS from the AWS-managed prefix list for CloudFront, and remove the other inbound rules.

options.label: D
options.text: Configure CloudFront to add a secret custom header to origin requests, and add a listener rule that forwards only the requests that carry that header.

options.label: E
options.text: Run an AWS Lambda function each day that reads the published CloudFront IP ranges and rewrites the inbound rules of the security group of the load balancer.

items.stem: A company runs a TCP application on Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer in us-east-1. A standby copy runs behind a second Network Load Balancer in a second Region, us-west-2. An AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator has one listener with an endpoint group for the us-east-1 load balancer. During normal operation, all traffic must go to us-east-1. If the us-east-1 endpoints become unhealthy, traffic must move to us-west-2 automatically. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Set the traffic dial of the us-west-2 endpoint group to 0 percent, and keep the traffic dial of the us-east-1 endpoint group at 100 percent.

options.label: B
options.text: Create a second accelerator for the us-west-2 load balancer, and create Amazon Route 53 failover records with health checks that point to the two accelerators.

options.label: C
options.text: Set the weight of the us-west-2 Network Load Balancer endpoint to 0, and keep the weight of the us-east-1 endpoint at its default value.

options.label: D
options.text: Set the client affinity of the listener to Source IP, so that each client keeps using the us-east-1 endpoints while those endpoints stay healthy.

options.label: E
options.text: Add an endpoint group for us-west-2 to the existing listener, and register the us-west-2 Network Load Balancer in that endpoint group as an endpoint.

items.stem: A company runs a photo-sharing mobile app. Users upload photos with HTTP PUT requests through an Amazon CloudFront distribution to an Amazon S3 bucket, and other users download the photos through the same distribution. The bucket must not be publicly accessible, and users must not reach the bucket directly. The company wants to restrict bucket access to the distribution. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Configure origin access control on the S3 origin, allow PUT in the cache behavior, and let the bucket policy allow the distribution to get and put objects.

options.label: B
options.text: Make the bucket policy allow public reads and writes, and change the app so that it sends every upload and download to the CloudFront domain name.

options.label: C
options.text: Configure an origin access identity (OAI) on the S3 origin, allow PUT in the cache behavior, and let the bucket policy allow the OAI to get and put objects.

options.label: D
options.text: Send uploads to an Amazon API Gateway REST API with an AWS Lambda function that writes each photo to the bucket, and use origin access control for downloads.

items.stem: A company sells online courses. It stores the course files in an Amazon S3 bucket and delivers them to learners through an Amazon CloudFront distribution in the same AWS account. A solutions architect must restrict access to the course files. Every visitor of the website can download the files, but nobody can download them with Amazon S3 URLs. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Add a bucket policy that allows public reads of the objects for requests that carry the domain name of the website in the Referer header.

options.label: B
options.text: Serve the files through an application on Amazon EC2 instances that checks each request and reads the objects from the bucket with an IAM role.

options.label: C
options.text: Add a trusted key group to the cache behavior, and have the application create a CloudFront signed URL for each file after the user signs in.

options.label: D
options.text: Configure origin access control on the S3 origin, and add a bucket policy that allows the CloudFront service principal to read objects for this distribution only.

items.stem: A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer in ap-southeast-2. The company adds an Amazon CloudFront distribution for www.example.com in front of the load balancer. Both connections, from viewers to CloudFront and from CloudFront to the load balancer, must use HTTPS so that data stays encrypted in transit. Both must use public certificates from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM), and the load balancer will use a certificate for origin.example.com. Where should the company request the two certificates?

options.label: A
options.text: Request both certificates in ap-southeast-2, where the application runs, and select each certificate in the distribution and in the load balancer.

options.label: B
options.text: Request the www.example.com certificate in US East (N. Virginia) for the distribution, and the origin.example.com certificate in ap-southeast-2 for the load balancer.

options.label: C
options.text: Use the default CloudFront certificate for www.example.com, and request the origin.example.com certificate in ap-southeast-2 for the load balancer.

options.label: D
options.text: Request both certificates in US East (N. Virginia), and select each certificate in the distribution and in the load balancer.

items.stem: A company runs an online service on Amazon EC2 instances behind Application Load Balancers in us-east-1 and us-west-2. An AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator has an endpoint group for each Region, and us-west-2 has enough capacity for all users. Users reach the service through a Route 53 alias record for the accelerator. The operations team must apply an operating system patch to the us-east-1 instances, and the patch restarts each instance. The patching must cause minimal downtime for users. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Launch a patched fleet behind a new load balancer in us-east-1, add it to the endpoint group, and remove the old load balancer after its connections close.

options.label: B
options.text: Change the Route 53 record of the service from the accelerator to the us-west-2 load balancer, wait one minute, patch the instances, and change the record back.

options.label: C
options.text: Set the traffic dial of the us-east-1 endpoint group to 0, wait until the existing connections close, patch the instances, and set the dial back to 100.

options.label: D
options.text: Set the traffic dial of the us-east-1 endpoint group to 0, patch the instances right away because open connections move to us-west-2, and then set the dial back.
